hero_emdash: A beloved school. A shared future.
hero_intro: Our vision is to bring this beloved former school back to life with affordable senior apartments, community event space, and a family funhouse.
hero_tiny: Follow our family as we learn, explore, and share our adventures in bringing an old school back to life.
story_heading: Honoring a School’s History. Imagining a New Future.
story_large: We’re a family from New Jersey with two kids, a dog, and a desire to do something different.
story_p1: A midlife crisis can take many forms. Ours just happened to involve buying a 31,000-square-foot elementary school in Pennsylvania.
story_p2: We don’t have all the answers, and we’re learning as we go. With plenty of determination, a willingness to learn, and a little help from friends, we’re working to give this beloved building a new purpose.
story_p3: Our vision is to create affordable apartments for seniors, welcoming spaces for neighbors to gather, and a place where families can come together and make lasting memories.
